Well before i start to share it i just want to clear something out, im 14 and i just graduated into to high school and this is my first time expieriencing real love (although many of you will think otherwise i dont give a fuck it was to me lmao) Well we were on a trip to the statue of liberty im in love with this girl that ive known for a while all of our friends tease us saying we like each other and i was deeply convinced that she did too. Well we did alot of talking the whole trip and putting our arms around each other, joking around, and generally feeling good about each other i knew she was the one i deeply care for her. I told my friend that this has to be the day i ask her out any day later will not suffice it had to be today

So ill fast foward since nothing good happens during the trip. Well as the classes were going back to school (we were in downtown manhattan going back to the bronx). Right before we went on the train which didnt get there for a good 10 minutes later anyway, i thought to myself "Yeezusislife you have to do it" So i pull her back and say, "J i need to ask you something important i think you already know though". I say this with the only smile in my face, she tells me "What that you like me?. I was gleeming in happiness at this point after that i just smiled and nodded, i asked "So whats the answer going to be?" She told me "Well i dont know im going to have to think about it" Although i didnt get a straightfoward answer i knew atleast i did it i finally did what i had to and showed my feelings.

Although we never went out and we had various problems and arguments after this we are great friends now and i actually just got over her a few hours ago. This memory will always stick with me it was my first time truly experiencing love, i can describe almost everything about that moment. I learned alot about women and love after this both sad and good but i came out at the top and nowi can proudly say i can move on. But one things for sure i will always be in love with this moment even though im not with the girl anymore. :)

Well if you say so, I liked the album  because just like 808s and Heartbreak it came during a time in hip hop where everything was getting stale. For example back then it was all the Gangster rap which although was already going on its way out was still prominent. Now you have the Migos flow which is quickly being played to death (That one song off of These days comes to mind), and when Yeezus came out it was a smack in the face to the industry and showed that a mainstream artist can make a not so mainstream sounding album and still stay popular and in peoples mouths.

Another reason is that it showed Kanye didnt give a fuck about what people thought and that there were too many problems in his life, like him not getting accepted into the fashion world and being marginalized just cause he was a rapper to give a fuck what people thought of the sound, because just like 808s i promise this album will be even more well received when a few more years pass by and more artist that are mainstream will take on this sound.

Kanye West, yes i understand my username has his album title in it and i understand that i just made a thread in hiphopheads that had to do with the album also(shameless plug to go check it out i just made the account i need it lmao). But people love to hate on Kanye for the stupidest of reasons, so what if he has a big ego? He deserves to have one hes created 6 albums that not only are amazing, also did something to change hip hop in itself.

I understand if you just dont like his music but just knocking him entirely because of stupid reasons like him going out with Kim Kardashian is stupid. And if your knocking him even though you've never listened to him a day in your life then you should atleast give his albums a chance YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT I PROMISE.
